proceduralGraphCompare.title: Sambal Bakar Pencok 89 Menu Clinical Evaluation
proceduralGraphCompare.recommended: Paket Kembung / Paket Uduk Kembung (Grilled Mackerel Set)
proceduralGraphCompare.clinicalTradeOffs: To address your high LDL and HbA1c while respecting your recent caloric and sodium overages, select the 'Paket Kembung' (requesting grilled preparation instead of fried). Mackerel is naturally rich in heart-healthy Omega-3 fatty acids that help improve your lipid profile without adding harmful trans or saturated fats. Pair this with a side of Sayur Asem for hydrating, low-calorie fiber that blunts glycemic spikes. Avoid all Tier 3 deep-fried sets and Tier 4 salted fish/organ satays to keep sodium and saturated fats well within your daily limits.
